responsibility: Provides the NEON/VFP scheduling model component for Cortex-A9. It classifies SIMD and floating-point instructions into Cortex-A9-specific categories and assigns reservations and bypasses for vector integer, multiply, shift, permute, load/store, and VFP/NEON transfer operations, supplying the SIMD/FPU half of the full Cortex-A9 microarchitecture model.
